ex: Keep your belt fastened; this is going to be quite a bumpy ride.

senses.d: A band that is used in a machine to help transfer motion or power.
ex: The motor had a single belt that snaked its way back and forth around a variety of wheels.

senses.d: To hit a pitched ball a long distance, usually for a home run.

senses.d: To scream or sing in a loud, strong manner.
ex: He belted out the national anthem.

senses.d: To drink quickly, often in gulps.
ex: He belted down a shot of whisky.

senses.d: To move, run, drive, etc., very fast.
